stories.title: Chinese state media stresses stability to set the tone for Xi-Trump summit

en.title: Chinese state media stresses stability to set the tone for Xi-Trump summit
en.summary: China's state media has emphasized the importance of constructive strategic stability ahead of a planned summit between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Washington. Beijing has also outlined its red lines before the high-level talks between the two powers.

stories.title: Invisible pixels protect South Korean graduates’ photos from deepfake abuse

en.title: Invisible pixels protect South Korean graduates' photos from deepfake abuse
en.summary: Seoul National University has embedded anti-deepfake technology into graduation photos to prevent misuse following a previous incident where female graduates' portraits were manipulated into explicit images. The university used StealCut Protect, created by SNU alumni, marking the first such application at a Korean university.

stories.title: Stand News editor had no intention of harming national security, court hears

en.title: Stand News editor had no intention of harming national security, court hears
en.summary: A former acting chief editor of the now-defunct Stand News argued he was performing his publishing duties without intent to undermine Hong Kong's national security, though the outlet was previously found liable for sedition and the trial judge noted the material contained false information with seditious effects.

stories.title: 企业境外反垄断合规指引修订草案公开征求意见

en.title: Revised Draft of Enterprise Overseas Antitrust Compliance Guide Solicits Public Comments
en.summary: China's market regulator is seeking public feedback on a revised draft guide for enterprises' overseas antitrust compliance, aiming to strengthen companies' awareness of antitrust laws abroad and reduce legal risks. The deadline for submitting comments is September 29, 2026.

stories.title: 打球、逛集、看非遗！这场农牧民“排球盛宴”料很足

en.title: Playing ball, browsing markets, watching intangible cultural heritage! This farmers and herders' 'volleyball feast' promises to be rich
en.summary: A volleyball event for farmers and herders features sporting competition alongside cultural activities including markets and displays of intangible cultural heritage.

stories.title: Were the Serbian military’s new robot dogs built using Chinese technology?

en.title: Were the Serbian military's new robot dogs built using Chinese technology?
en.summary: Serbia displayed armed robot dogs during a military exercise shortly after opening a Chinese robotics factory, raising questions about whether the technology incorporates Chinese innovation into Serbian weapons systems.

stories.title: 中国队获得亚运会男子4x100米混合泳接力冠军

en.title: China's team wins Asian Games men's 4x100 metres mixed medley relay championship
en.summary: China's swimming team comprising Xu Jiaoyu, Dong Zhihao, Xu Fang, and Pan Zhanle captured the Asian Games men's 4x100 metres mixed medley relay title with a time of 3 minutes 27.89 seconds.

stories.title: Indonesia presses ahead with Russian oil imports despite ‘real risk’ of US penalties

en.title: Indonesia presses ahead with Russian oil imports despite 'real risk' of US penalties
en.summary: Indonesia intends to continue importing discounted Russian crude oil to address energy security and budget concerns, even as the US authorizes sanctions and potential tariffs of up to 100 percent on major Russian oil buyers.

stories.title: Chinese son’s video of mum’s final 14 days before sudden leukaemia death moves hearts online

en.title: Chinese son's video of mum's final 14 days before sudden leukaemia death moves hearts online
en.summary: A man from Inner Mongolia documented his mother's rapid decline over two weeks following a leukaemia diagnosis, capturing her deterioration from a healthy state to her death in a video that resonated with online audiences.

stories.title: Amazon and Shorea Capital deals underscore foreign interest in commercial property

en.title: Amazon and Shorea Capital deals underscore foreign interest in commercial property
en.summary: Foreign investors including Amazon and Singapore-based Shorea Capital are acquiring commercial real estate assets in Hong Kong, with Shorea recently purchasing The Pemberton, a mixed-use property in Sheung Wan.

stories.title: Hong Kong regulators to flesh out new yuan strategy after Beijing meetings

en.title: Hong Kong regulators to flesh out new yuan strategy after Beijing meetings
en.summary: Hong Kong and Beijing are developing a new phase of offshore yuan development following the city's first five-year plan, with financial regulators preparing to release additional details on the strategy.

stories.title: BlackRock gains QDII status in China’s US$149b market as Beijing leans into opening up

en.title: BlackRock gains QDII status in China's US$149b market as Beijing leans into opening up
en.summary: BlackRock became the first wholly foreign-owned public fund manager to obtain QDII status in China, allowing it to raise funds domestically and invest them in overseas securities.

stories.title: Hisense unit gains in Hong Kong debut amid rush of mainland Chinese corporate spin-offs

en.title: Hisense unit gains in Hong Kong debut amid rush of mainland Chinese corporate spin-offs
en.summary: Ligent Technologies, the optical communications unit of Hisense Group, raised HK$5.6 billion in its Hong Kong listing, reflecting a trend of mainland Chinese conglomerates spinning off divisions to access overseas capital.

stories.title: Hong Kong stocks eye fresh inflows from mainland China’s insurers sitting on US$6 trillion

en.title: Hong Kong stocks eye fresh inflows from mainland China's insurers sitting on US$6 trillion
en.summary: Hong Kong's stock market may receive significant investment from mainland China's insurance sector, valued at 41 trillion yuan, after regulators permitted insurers to purchase exchange-traded funds in the city. Trading volume spikes in Hong Kong-listed ETFs suggest mainland insurance companies have begun making such purchases.
